narrative.intro: Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory obligated $85.3M in federal contract funds in FY2027 to date. Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory received 6 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $14.2M. Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory obligations are down 96.1% year over year. Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory obligations for prior fiscal years show much larger totals: FY22 was $1.6B, FY23 was $2B, FY24 was $2B, FY25 was $2.4B, and FY26 was $2.2B. Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory had one buying agency reporting obligations in FY2027 to date: the National Aeronautics and Space Administration obligated $85.3M. Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory had the Department of Homeland Security listed with $0 obligations this fiscal year. This snapshot covers contract obligations and notes that award-value figures in other tables are total contract values, while the current-year totals are partial and fiscal year to date.
